description: This Java class `PersonAttributeEditor` serves as a property editor for the `PersonAttribute` class in the OpenMRS project. It facilitates serializing and deserializing `PersonAttribute` objects to and from string representations, enabling data transfer within web forms or other mediums. It includes methods for retrieving `PersonAttribute` objects by their ID or UUID via the `Context.getPersonService()` API.

classes.name: PersonAttributeEditor
classes.description: A property editor class for serializing and deserializing `PersonAttribute` objects, with methods to retrieve instances by ID or UUID.

methods.name: getObjectById
methods.description: Retrieves a `PersonAttribute` object by its integer ID using the OpenMRS `PersonService`.

methods.name: getObjectByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a `PersonAttribute` object by its UUID string using the OpenMRS `PersonService`.
